info.name: Solutions API
info.description: API collection for Solutions - Static enum-based configuration endpoints. Solutions are now static enums (PRODUCTION, EVENTS, PHOTOGRAPHY) without database tables.

request.description: Get all solution configurations (public endpoint). Returns static configuration for all solution keys: PRODUCTION, EVENTS, PHOTOGRAPHY.

variable.description: Solution key: PRODUCTION, EVENTS, or PHOTOGRAPHY

request.description: Get solution configuration by key (public endpoint). Key must be one of: PRODUCTION, EVENTS, PHOTOGRAPHY (case-insensitive).
